posts.title: For submariners
posts.description: There might be very little support resources for us among the plethora of support/care/healing/guidance/empower/discover/transform things. We have trained for eons to operate locally/self-reliantly. Not counting on support to reach us. Not expecting to receive stuff. To figure things out entirely within the confines of our vessel. And those are not bad things or failings. This is where it can get

posts.title: Continuity
posts.description: Contributing to continuity and access is no less than having invented the thing in the first place.
